lines.en: I move along slowly.

lines.zh: 灰白的皮毛上沾着草屑
lines.en: Grass clings to my ashen coat.

lines.zh: 蹄子压过草地,声音很闷
lines.en: My hooves press the grass with a dull sound.
Head down, I look for grass as I walk.
The bell on my neck stays quiet.
I round a small clump of bushes.
Another of my kind walks the slope.
I pause at each step, unhurried.
My tail flicks off two flies.
I amble along the fence line.
My shadow shifts along with me.

lines.zh: 我踩到一块硬土,停了停
lines.en: I step on hard earth and pause.
A little further in, there is more grass.
My weight makes each step heavy.
I raise my head to check my heading.
It is early yet; no need to hurry.
I stand and chew without moving.
My ashen coat shifts in the wind.
I toss my head with force.
The grass at my mouth is still unswallowed.
I blink slowly once.
Flies are circling behind me.
I have stood on this slope a while.

lines.zh: 我抬脚蹭了蹭另一条腿
lines.en: I rub one leg against the other.
This pasture is quiet.
I blow out a breath.
I stand firm as a stone.
Someone is working in the distance.
I lower my head and lift it again.
The sun bleaches my grey coat.
I chew slowly and finely.
This is my day.
I lift my head toward you.

lines.zh: 灰白的身影映在你眼里
lines.en: My ashen shape is mirrored in your eyes.
Is that grass in your hand?
I lean a little closer.
I am content with you standing there.
I sniff your sleeve.
You are much shorter than the fence.
I blink once.
I nudge you with my nose.
Do not stand behind me.
I turn around slowly.
Go ahead and touch; I do not mind.
I give a low cry and back off.
My hide is cut open.
I circle, tail lashing.
I can no longer stand steady.
That one truly hurt.
I am panting harder and harder.
I retreat toward my kind.
Blood drips onto the grass.
I do not like this.
An ashen cow with sharp horns.
Grass; I smell it.
I move toward it, step by step.
Give me that handful.
That smells fresh.
I stretch my tongue for the grass.
I can eat a lot.
I follow you a few steps.
One more step and I can reach it.
Do not take it away; I am not done.
Better than the grass on the slope.
Walking and chewing, the grass is not down yet.
Set it down; I will eat it myself.
I lower my neck to reach it.
This will keep me chewing a while.
Let me sniff first.
I will not be polite about this.
You hit my ribs and bounced off.
I hardly felt a thing.
I am too heavy to push.
I am crowded half a step aside.
My hoof nearly came down on you.
Watch your feet when you walk.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起,毛都乱了
lines.en: We bump, and my coat ruffles.
You are far more impatient than I.
I slowly shift my body aside.
Next time go around the side.
I stand against your flank.
We lower our heads to graze together.
I swish my tail; so do you.
This pasture is enough for both of us.
I rest my head gently.
You go ahead; I will follow.
Our ashen shadows merge.
Walk slowly; there is no rush.
With you here, there are fewer flies.
At dusk we return to the pen.
I lower my head and take it.
Can this be swallowed?
I chew two or three times.
A bit tough, but fine.
I curl my tongue and pull it in.
This does not belong on the ground.
I carry it and walk slowly off.
Put it back on the ground.
Strange taste.

lines.zh: 我用鼻尖把它拱回给你。
lines.en: I nudge it back to you with my nose.
Is that a living thing standing over there?

lines.zh: 我这一身灰白，像烧过的纸。
lines.en: This ashen coat looks like burnt paper.
I feel a little uneasy.
I move closer to my own kind.
This is not someone bringing grass.
I back into the herd before stopping.
I stop grazing.
My kind look up too.
What do you mean to do?
I blow a breath out of my nose.
My eyes have never left you.
Come near, and I go.
I drift toward the fence.
An ashen body does not hide well.
I low softly.
Ashen backs press into one mass.
One step closer and I run.
I will not strike first.
I watch the grass in your hand.
I know the way behind me.
I lower my head and charge.
My horns are not full, but they serve.
My hoof stamps forward.
This blow is to defend myself.
The shove sends you back two steps.
I have been pushed too far.
I throw my head hard.
I am breathing in heavy gusts.
Do not make me keep at this.
I only wanted to graze in peace.
I come slowly down the slope.

lines.zh: 灰白的皮在晨光里发亮
lines.en: My ashen hide gleams in the dawn.
I set down my first hoof.
Two others follow behind me.
I lower my head for the first bite.
The wind brings the smell of grass.
I call once, deeply.
I stop and survey the meadow.
The bell rings softly once.
I drift out to graze.
My coat burns and smells scorched.
I land on all four hooves, numb.
Water pours in through my nostrils.
I am lifted clean off the ground.
An arrow sticks in my shoulder.
That force weakens my legs.
My empty belly aches.
Lightning runs down my spine.
I cannot find the ground.
